description: verifyAccount: Verify a newly created OSIR account with the code from the verification email; step 2 of onboarding, no authentication required. The code is the same token as the email link, so the principal can relay it to their agent. On success the account becomes ACTIVE and billable actions are unlocked. If the code expired, call createAccount again with the same email to get a fresh one.

code.description: Verification code from the email sent by createAccount.

name: verifyAccount
